en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front image displays an old photograph of a building labeled 'HÔTEL GRAND' and 'Hotell Grand, Sundsvall', revealing a historic hotel in what appears to be a small city with classic Northern European architecture. The reverse side features handwritten Swedish text, two green Swedish stamps (5 öre), a postmark from 'NJURUN-', and is addressed to Fröken Lillan Liodin, adr. Braathen, Artillerigat. 77, Stockholm. There is also a logo for Svenska Litografiska AB, Stockholm.
